description: Games and matches that have captured bet365 prices, soonest first, with the markets each has. Use an event_id with get_bet365_odds or get_bet365_line_history. Needs an API key.

event_id.description: An event id from list_bet365_events, such as an-295471 or espn-401879233.

from.description: ISO time. Events starting at or after it. Default: 6 hours ago.

league.description: League code, such as nba, nfl, nhl, ncaaf, ncaab, mlb, epl, serie-a, bundesliga, ligue-1 or ucl. get_bet365_coverage lists what is captured now.

live.description: true for in-play prices only, false for pre-match only.

to.description: ISO time. Events starting before it.

user_request.description: The current user task in one sentence. Leave out secrets and personal data.

name: list_bet365_events
